name: Crescent Blade
body:
Price 10 gp; Type light melee Proficiency exotic (crescent blade) Damage (Medium) 1d4 slashing. Damage (Small) 1d3 slashing. Critical 19–20/×2 Range 10 ft. Special performance Weight 2 lbs.

Crescent blades look similar to foot-wide pendulum scythes attached to a short cord or chain. These spinning blades are exceptionally challenging to use, causing the wielder to take a –2 penalty on attack rolls. However, due to their speed and flexibility, they grant wielders a +2 bonus on attack rolls (instead of the penalty) when making attacks of opportunity provoked by movement.
